claims.text: The driver's own cancellation reason code is DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is the driver's admission that he could not find the rider. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to be terminated with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is expressly excluded and does not satisfy limb (d). The anchor clause for the charge therefore fails on its own terms and the fee is not chargeable.

The driver's in-geofence dwell was 200 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:11:48 to the last at 19:15:08. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), but the minimum dwell for a STANDARD zone class under the fee schedule is 300 seconds, and the derived arrival block reports a shortfall of -20 seconds against the longest_run_sec basis. The effective dwell is shorter than the required minimum, so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present.

The rider was present and actively coordinating. The rider's track places the device within 12.5 to 19.7 metres of the pickup pin across 40 fixes, all inside the 100 m rider_presence_radius_m for STANDARD, and the rider sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby') at 19:12:48. The driver's only message was at 19:12:18 and the driver cancelled at 19:15:10 without replying to the rider's message within 120 seconds and without any in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). Under POL-NS-04 the rider is exonerated and the fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation.

The driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it: the derived arrival block reports 21 qualifying in-geofence fixes with a longest qualifying run of 200 seconds starting at 19:11:48, and the driver's minimum distance to the pin was 0.44 m. Because the driver was inside the radius, POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance, outside radius but within 400 m) does not apply and cannot be used to route the fee to a goodwill payment; the case is governed by POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-06.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02748-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and no payload. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i) a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulation limb unavailable, so the driver cannot use a kerb restriction, enforcement, closure or accident to sum separate in-geofence intervals or to excuse the shortfall. The absence is itself citable and it removes the only route by which the driver could have reached the required minimum.

The fare ledger shows the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was charged to the rider and remains CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The amount contested is SGD 4.50, which is the cancellation-fee line only; no booking or platform fee was charged on this cancelled trip, so the full refund of the cancellation fee is the complete remedy and it is within the automatic execution threshold.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1 against completed_trips_30d of 137, a rate of 0.007, which is far below the 0.08 threshold and the count is below 4. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so no escalation is triggered on that basis and the rider's refund is not displaced by an escalation under POL-NS-09(d).

claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous qualifying run of 200 seconds, from 19:11:48 to 19:15:08, with 21 qualifying fixes — so POL-NS-02's arrival test is met and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:11:48 and a wait timer started at 19:11:50, and the driver held position until he cancelled at 19:15:10 — a recorded wait of 3.4 minutes, which is the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip plus a further 20 seconds.

The driver's arrival marker is not false: the trace shows him stationary at the pickup pin (min_distance_m 0.44 m) with a distinct speed of 0.0 kph across the dwell, so POL-NS-05's 300 m and 15 kph triggers are not engaged and the waiting clock runs from the arrival event as recorded.

The rider was present and stationary within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius throughout — 40 qualifying rider fixes, all at 0.0 kph, mean distance 16.2 m from the pin — so the rider was not prevented from boarding by distance or movement.

The chat log shows the driver asked 'cannot find you, where are you' at 19:12:18 and the rider replied 'at the lift lobby' at 19:12:48 — a sub-location the driver could not act on within the remaining wait, and the driver's message was read at 19:12:43, so the rider was on notice of the driver's difficulty before the cancellation at 19:15:10.

The rider's own message names only 'the lift lobby' and no block, tower or entrance identifier, and the trip record carries a single registered pickup point (registered_pickup_points = 1) with a venue_id (VEN-JW-ST61) — so this is not a POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity case and the rider's own locating message does not establish that the driver failed to move to a stated sub-location.

The fare breakdown reconciles: the cancellation fee line of SGD 4.50 equals the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd in force for this trip, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the charge is the correct net figure.

The driver's anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 1/137 = 0.007 is far below the 0.08 rate limb, so compensation is payable at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, i.e. SGD 3.60, and the ruling on the fee is NO_ACTION with the charge standing.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d = 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0, and the driver's shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0, so neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) escalation trigger is engaged on the profile counters.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulated dwell is unavailable and cannot be asserted — but the driver does not need it, because the single in-geofence run of 200 seconds already exceeds the 180 second minimum dwell for STANDARD.

The GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100 percent coverage, 10 second cadence, zero gaps and both tracks present, and the trip record is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 — so the deciding facts of arrival and dwell rest on clean, unimpaired evidence and no POL-NS-08 or POL-NS-09(e) impairment escalation arises.

The driver's cancellation reason code is DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which does not satisfy POL-NS-01 limb (d) on its face — I concede that limb (d) is not met on the recorded code, and the fee therefore cannot stand under POL-NS-01 alone; the driver's position is that the underlying facts (arrival, full dwell, rider present but not boarding) are a genuine no-show and the mis-selected code is a driver-education item, not a rider windfall.

ruling.explanation: Both parties: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02748 is refunded in FULL to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable. The charge cannot stand under POL-NS-01, the anchor clause, which requires all four of its limbs. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and it expressly excludes DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02748) records exactly that code, and the driver has properly conceded the point. The other limbs do hold: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02748) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at the pickup pin for a continuous run of 200 seconds (19:11:48-19:15:08) with 21 qualifying fixes, which exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). Because the driver's stationary fixes were INSIDE the arrival radius and the reason code was DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, POL-NS-01 directs a full refund of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation and a driver-education referral for the mis-selected code. The rider would in any event be exonerated under POL-NS-04: he sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby', EV-CHAT-02748, 19:12:48) inside the waiting window; the driver neither replied within 120 seconds of it nor placed any in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty); and the rider's own track (EV-GPS-02748) places his device 12.5-19.7 m from the pin, well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, across 40 qualifying fixes. Claims addressed: the driver's claim that compensation of SGD 3.60 (80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee) is payable and the ruling should be NO_ACTION is rejected - POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not, so there is no standing fee to share out. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d 137, a rate of 0.007, EV-DPROF-02748), but that is not what defeats the compensation; limb (d) is. The rider's POL-NS-06 shortfall claim is rejected: it compares the 200-second dwell against fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec of 300 s for STANDARD, and the fee_schedule resolution rule states that figure is retained only for records authored before policy version 2 and is never applied to a record carrying platform_policy; the free waiting period in force is 180 s and the 200-second dwell exceeds it. POL-NS-03 is not engaged, because the driver was inside the arrival radius and not in the 50-400 m wrong-entrance band, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises and neither party gets to re-route the fee to it. Weight and escalation: the GPS trace and the trip record are both COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 with 100 percent coverage and no gaps, and the counterparty statement (DRIVER, 2026-09-19) independently records the driver's inability to locate the rider, so the deciding facts rest on unimpaired evidence; the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02748-01, weight 0.0) carries no deciding fact in this case. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires - confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts do not contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, the profile counters show no repeat dispute between these parties, and no anti-farming pattern is present. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and the charge (currently CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, EV-FARE-02748) is to be refunded in full. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
referrals: POL-NS-01: record a driver-education item against driver DRV-09748 for the mis-selected cancellation reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE on trip TRP-02748 - the no-show fee was refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this is a provisional ruling issued without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. It rests on trip record EV-TRIP-02748, GPS trace EV-GPS-02748, chat log EV-CHAT-02748 and fare breakdown EV-FARE-02748.

Outcome. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02748 is refunded to the rider in full (amount_sgd 4.50). No driver compensation is payable. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02748) shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; the contested amount is 4.50, the cancellation-fee line only, with no separate booking or platform fee. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold of POL-GEN-05 and so executes on issue.

Why the charge falls. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only where all four of its limbs hold. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver for RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record records the cancellation under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and the driver's own statement says he 'could not locate the rider'. DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's admission that he could not find the rider, is expressly excluded by limb (d), and no Singapore platform charges a no-show fee on a cancellation recorded under any reason other than the rider's failure to appear. The anchor clause fails and the fee cannot stand.

Which branch applies. The driver's own GPS trace places his stationary fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — a continuous qualifying run of 200 seconds from 19:11:48 to 19:15:08, 21 qualifying fixes, minimum distance to the pin 0.44 m — so this is the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome on which POL-NS-01 itself fixes the remedy: the fee is not chargeable, the rider is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the mis-selected reason code is recorded in referrals as a driver-education item. POL-NS-04 reaches the same result independently: the rider sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby') at 19:12:48 inside the waiting window, the driver neither replied within 120 seconds of it nor made any in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty), and the rider's track keeps the device inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius on all 40 qualifying fixes (mean 16.2 m); the rider is exonerated and the refund is in full with no driver compensation.

The parties' points, answered. The driver's claims that he arrived inside the radius (POL-NS-02), that he held a recorded wait longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force (POL-NS-01(c)), and that he did not mark arrival falsely (POL-NS-05) are accepted: he was at the pin, held 200 seconds against the 180-second free_wait_sec carried in platform_policy, and was stationary at 0.0 kph when he tapped. Those findings are why this is an in-radius outcome, but they do not save the fee, because limb (d) still fails. His point that the rider was present within the rider-presence radius is accepted and tells against the fee rather than for it. His points that POL-NS-03 pin-ambiguity does not apply (a single registered pickup point; the rider naming only 'the lift lobby') and that the fare line reconciles to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd are accepted: there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect and no goodwill payment arises. His claim for SGD 3.60 compensation under POL-NS-07 with a NO_ACTION disposition of the fee is rejected: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and limb (d) fails, so the precondition is not met and there is no fee to compensate — the anti-farming arithmetic (1 termination against 137 completed trips) is correct but the clause does not apply. His concession that limb (d) is not met on the recorded code is accepted and is decisive. His points that no escalation trigger is engaged and that the evidence is clean are accepted.

The rider's claim of a POL-NS-06 waiting-period shortfall is rejected. It reads the minimum dwell as 300 seconds from fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec, but that figure is retained only to interpret records authored before policy version 2 and is never applied to a record carrying platform_policy; this trip carries platform_policy, so the period in force is the 180-second free_wait_sec. The measured in-geofence dwell of 200 seconds exceeds 180 seconds — the derived block reports shortfall_sec -20.0, a surplus of 20 seconds — so POL-NS-06 does not fire and does not decide this case. The rider's claims that limb (d) fails, that POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider, that POL-NS-03 is inapplicable because the fixes lie inside the radius, that the full SGD 4.50 is the correct remedy, and that the anti-farming check does not trip are accepted.

Confidence and impairment. Confidence is 0.95, within the 1.0 cap set by the artifacts carrying the deciding facts — EV-TRIP-02748, EV-GPS-02748 and EV-CHAT-02748, each at weight_multiplier 1.0. None is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): no clock skew (the arrival event at 19:11:48 matches a trace fix at 19:11:48), no trace gap, both tracks present at 100 per cent coverage, chat sequence and message count reconcile, and the fare line reconciles. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no two artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, no repeat-counterparty pattern exists (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0), the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence.

Referral. POL-NS-01 directs that the mis-selected reason code be recorded for driver education; that clause-mandated instruction is carried in the referrals list and does not affect the money.
referrals: POL-NS-01: driver education — the no-show fee on trip TRP-02748 was recorded under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which does not support a no-show charge; record the mis-selected reason code against driver DRV-09748 as a driver-education item.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver. The contested amount is the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-02748, charged at 19:15:27 and still standing on the ledger (EV-FARE-02748). I am refunding it in full to the rider, and the driver receives nothing.

Why the charge cannot stand. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold. Three do: (a) the trip record (EV-TRIP-02748) carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:11:48; (b) the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02748) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 19:11:48, the first qualifying in-geofence fix; and (c) he held position inside that geofence continuously for 200 seconds, from 19:11:48 to 19:15:08, which exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). Condition (d) fails on the driver's own record: he terminated the trip with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01 expressly excludes that code from the three that satisfy limb (d). The driver concedes this. Where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius — as they do here, his minimum distance to the pin being 0.44 m — POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome: the fee is not chargeable, the rider is refunded the SGD 4.50 in full, and no driver compensation is payable. The mis-selected reason code goes into the referrals as a driver-education item.

The rider is independently exonerated under POL-NS-04. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02748) shows the rider sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby') at 19:12:48; the driver posted no reply in the 120 seconds that followed and made no in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty); and the rider's own device sat within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius on all 40 qualifying fixes, 12.5–19.7 m from the pin throughout. Both routes give the same result: full refund of the SGD 4.50, no compensation.

On the driver's claim for SGD 3.60 compensation: the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the 4-or-more limb; 1/137 = 0.007, below the 0.08 rate limb), but POL-NS-07 pays compensation only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. Compensation is therefore refused. There is no goodwill payment either: POL-NS-03(ii) applies only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the arrival radius (within 400 m), and here they were inside it, so POL-NS-03 does not apply at all.

On the rider's POL-NS-06 argument (200-second dwell against a 300-second minimum): rejected. The 300-second figure in fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec is retained only to interpret records authored before policy version 2 and is never applied to a record that carries platform_policy; the free waiting period in force is 180 seconds, and the 200-second dwell exceeds it. The derived block's −20-second 'shortfall' is in fact a 20-second surplus against 180 seconds. POL-NS-06 does not apply. The arrival marker is also not false under POL-NS-05 — the driver was at the pin (0.44 m) and stationary at 0.0 kph, so neither the 300 m nor the 15 kph trigger is engaged, and no false-arrival referral arises.

Integrity and confidence. Every artifact this ruling rests on — EV-GPS-02748, EV-TRIP-02748, EV-CHAT-02748 and EV-FARE-02748 — is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0. There is no clock skew (the arrival event matches the first in-geofence fix to the second), no trace defect (100% coverage, 10-second cadence, zero gaps, both tracks present), no chat defect (2 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count), and the fare line reconciles exactly to the SGD 4.50 net fee, so there is no POL-NS-08 defect and no POL-NS-09 escalation. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02748-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); nothing in this ruling rests on it — POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is both unavailable and unnecessary, because there is a single continuous in-geofence run — so I record it, note it carries no deciding fact, and it does not cap confidence. Confidence is 0.95.

The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, which does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue. Both parties may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
